title: Generic splitting of a finite algebra after an etale base change
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian integral domain with fraction field $K$, and let $B$ be a finite $A$-algebra [pqf-lem-finite-integral-lft, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. There exist a nonzero $c\in A$, a finite etale surjective morphism $\operatorname{Spec}(A')\to\operatorname{Spec}(A[c^{-1}])$, and finite $A'$-algebras $D_1,\ldots,D_r$ such that the reduction $(B\otimes_A A')_{\mathrm{red}}$ is isomorphic to $\prod_{j=1}^r D_j$, each $D_j$ is a domain, and every $\operatorname{Spec}(D_j)\to\operatorname{Spec}(A')$ is finite, surjective, and a universal homeomorphism [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism].

proof.text: Pass to the generic fibre C=B tensor_A K. By [lem-weil-pbc-generic-separable-algebra-splitting], after a finite separable extension K'/K the reduction of C tensor_K K' is a finite product of fields L_j, each purely inseparable over K'.

By [lem-weil-pbc-spread-finite-separable-extension], after inverting a nonzero c in A the extension K'/K is the fraction-field extension of a finite etale A[c^{-1}]-algebra A'; the resulting morphism Spec(A') to Spec(A[c^{-1}]) is finite etale and surjective.

proof.text: For each purely inseparable field factor L_j, let D_j be the corresponding factor of (B tensor_A A')_red after the generic idempotents have been spread. After enlarging the localization once for the finitely many factors, each D_j is a finite A'-algebra domain with fraction field L_j, so [lem-weil-pbc-spread-purely-inseparable-factors] gives that Spec(D_j) to Spec(A') is surjective and radicial, hence a universal homeomorphism.

source.place: proof, finite-algebra calculation, purely inseparable factors

proof.text: Let e_j be the orthogonal generic idempotents giving the product decomposition in [lem-weil-pbc-generic-separable-algebra-splitting]. Since B tensor_A A' is finite over A', clear the finitely many denominators in the e_j and in the equations e_j^2=e_j, e_je_{j'}=0 (j not equal to j'), and sum_j e_j=1; after one principal localization these equations hold in the reduction of B tensor_A A'. The corresponding finite factors D_j have generic fraction fields L_j. After a further principal localization, make the reduced finite A'-module torsion free and clear generators and relations for the D_j; the spread idempotents then split (B tensor_A A')_red as the product of these domains D_j, each embedded in its generic field L_j. Applying [lem-weil-pbc-spread-purely-inseparable-factors] to each D_j supplies the finite, surjective, radicial, and universal-homeomorphism properties. This avoids any assertion about integral closures or equality with integral closures.
